_comment: Where a product can actually be bought. One entry per product, written once, and the guard checks every page against it. read_on is manual on purpose: ecoflow.com serves a JS shell to a plain fetch, and a scraper that breaks silently would be worse than none.

nrtl_compliance._comment: Which products a reader in an NRTL state can and cannot use. The state pages read this; nothing about price or arrival is typed into HTML.
nrtl_compliance.note: Amazon affiliate income only exists on the products that do not meet the requirement. As more states adopt UL 3700 the only products we earn from become the ones we should not be recommending. Recorded so the trade-off is visible rather than discovered later.
